title: Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance — Renewal Applications and the Renewal Claim of Medical Debt
content:
A patient holding an approved Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance (above 400% FPL) award under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) may file a renewal application within the award renewal window days before that award's award end date. The renewal opens a new case, the renewal case, on the household size, annual household income and liquid assets documented on the expiring award, with the household percent recomputed against the HHS poverty guideline in force on the renewal's application date and the tier that percent points to, and with no medical debt recorded on it (0.00) until the patient signs the renewal's claim of medical debt.

Only the patient signs that claim; the signed claim records on the renewal case the medical debt the renewal claims. The renewal claims only the patient's Riverbend bills, read from Riverbend's own records as of the signing day; the bills of any other provider are claimed only by sending them as outside medical bills and are not part of this claim.

### The renewal case at a glance

| Figure on the renewal case | Where it comes from |
|---|---|
| household size, annual household income, liquid assets | as documented on the expiring award |
| household percent and tier | recomputed against the HHS poverty guideline in force on the renewal's application date |
| medical debt | 0.00 until the patient signs the renewal's claim of medical debt; then the medical debt the renewal claims |

### Invocation of `sign_renewal_debt_claim_3b9e07c1`

The claim is the patient's own signature. The agent unlocks `sign_renewal_debt_claim_3b9e07c1` and hands it over, and the customer themselves (the patient) signs it through the Riverbend patient portal; a representative or the agent does not sign it.

Effect: the medical debt the signed claim states is recorded on the renewal case as the case's qualifying medical debt figure, replacing the figure shown there. The renewal case keeps its status, tier, application date and every other figure, and the approved award being renewed is left unchanged. The patient sees a confirmation that the claim was received on the renewal case together with the claimed amount now on file.

- `fap_case_id` — the reference number of the patient's renewal case, as shown by the financial assistance case lookup for this patient.
- `qualifying_medical_debt_usd` — the medical debt the renewal claims, in USD: a non-negative amount stated to 2 decimal places (cents), stored rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.

Receipt: "Renewal medical-debt claim received on case <case>; claimed medical debt on file: <amount> USD." The amount is the recorded figure with 2 decimal places; the receipt appearing means the claim is on the renewal case.
